purpose: Make an empty CONFIRMED set interpretable. Continuous evidence first, binary verdict second.

reviewerArithmetic.note: verified: EV = 3p - 1 - cost. p=0.406 gives +0.10R net. The reviewer's ~41% is correct.

gates.label: NO_BASELINE veto — no fine AND no coarse cell

gateStackNote: G0 Amendment 3 RESTORED RULE: CONFIRMED = (net mean > +0.10R AND day-clustered t(net) > 2) AND (excess over matched random > 0 AND day-clustered t(excess) > 2) AND all vetoes. The v1.2 'excess > 0.10 and net > 0' rule is GONE. Two old multiplicative gates (weakness requirement, sweep veto) remain removed.

interpretationGuide.NEGATIVE_RESULT: well-powered cells with excess near zero -> the textbook claim is genuinely absent here
interpretationGuide.UNDERPOWERED: cannot distinguish 'no edge' from 'too little data'; do NOT claim the textbook is false
interpretationGuide.MIXED: report per-state; do not aggregate into one verdict
interpretationGuide.POSITIVE: CONFIRMED claims that also beat the placebo floor are eligible for the routing table

perClaimTemplate.rule: AMENDMENT 3: BOTH gates must pass (net mean > +0.10R with tNet > 2, AND excess > 0 with t > 2). An INCONCLUSIVE claim still reports both point estimates and CIs, its four-state diagnostics, its baseline coverage and the standard-exit caveat (reversion families). No verdict may be read from a four-state diagnostic.

m6Readout.primary: count of CONFIRMED claims with stability != DEFINITION_SENSITIVE
m6Readout.continuous: median and IQR of excessVsRandomR across all 48 claims
m6Readout.control: CONFIRMED count must exceed placebo p95 = 0
m6Readout.decision: If M6 returns zero CONFIRMED, the correct readout is UNDERPOWERED, not 'textbook is false'. Escalate to the G0 power decision rather than lowering criteria.

conditionalPolicy.decidedAt: G0 Amendment 2, 2026-10-27, before any claim result
conditionalPolicy.note: A CONFIRMED + DEFINITION_SENSITIVE claim is reported but DOES NOT ship. Enable only if VAL independently meets the frozen support criterion. See BLUEPRINT §7.10.2.

reportOnlyClusteredPower.note: Clustered-by-day SEs and overlapping family variants reduce effective power. No criterion changed.

amendment2: 2026-10-27: readout updated for clustered inference and CONDITIONAL default no. Verdict remains UNDERPOWERED.

reversionCaveat.label: under the standard exit (1.5 ATR stop, 2R target) only
reversionCaveat.note: Every verdict for these families is labelled with the standard exit only; no new exit in this cycle.

amendment3.note: Restored rule, 2 verdict states, NO_BASELINE veto, reversion exit caveat, empirical-study tiers. Verdict remains UNDERPOWERED; report-only power does not change any criterion.
